name: ESO 104-022 (Hubble)
blurb: ESO 104-022, an irregular galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: eso104022-hubble
story: A small irregular galaxy thought to belong to the group of galaxies around NGC 6744. Hubble measured the brightness of its red giant stars to learn how far away it lies.

claims.text: ESO 104-022 is an irregular galaxy, a supposed member of the NGC 6744 group, with a TRGB distance
The program measured distances to nearby galaxies from the luminosities of red giant branch stars, to build 3D maps of galaxies
